_doc: Release gate for the agents' prompts (scripts/prompt_gate.py). Runs handoff-routing on the a2a topology with the label under review. HARD metrics are deterministic: routing and trajectory from the run record, outcomes from the back-office ledger against the credit oracle; a miss blocks the release. SOFT metrics warn. A missing metric fails. 'compare' (with --compare production) bounds how far a metric may fall below the production label in the same gate run. Thresholds sit below the production baseline (SPEC §9: routing 0.97, context 0.97, resolution 1.00) so run-to-run noise does not fail a good prompt.
